'''Kemal Station''' was a [[Water/Legends|damp]], foggy,<ref name="TEA" /> terrestrial<ref name="Journal6" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemal]] in the [[Kemal Station system/Legends|Kemal Station system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Andooweel system/Legends|Andooweel]] and [[New Ator system/Legends|New Ator systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kemal Station served as an informal borderline between the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Regency Worlds]], which were primarily connected economically to commerce along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], and the worlds that were located [[spinward]] along the Triellus Trade Route and whose economies were dominated by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. As a result, Kemal Station serviced both legitimate [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the wealthy entrepreneur [[Meysen Kayson]] owned several properties on the moon.<ref name="Journal6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kemal Station was first mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] source article authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Journal6" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the moon in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
